intentional_contract_enhancements: Detector computation option bounds and BGR8 image validation reject invalid input explicitly.
deployment_changes: Default model is installed by the functional package and resolved from package://easyfly_object_detection/models/yolo11n.onnx; asset bytes unchanged.
ORT_ROOT remains overridable; copy matrix uses an external SDK-root symlink to the same audited SDK.
SDK runtime, providers, SONAME aliases and notices are installed only by easyfly_yolo_onnx.
limitations: Uses installed ROS/main/scene underlays; not a clean full-workspace build.
Synthetic ROS image/clock/calibration/landing observations plus real local CPU/CUDA inference; no physical sensor accuracy or flight validation.
Relocation covers exported CMake targets, native executable loading and model assets, not all generated colcon environment scripts.
The historical SDK archive hash is unknown; local payload hashes and metadata are retained.
ALG0-B02/B03 and historical semantic shutdown issue remain open.
